scoring_justification: The max increase and decrease can be recomputed from the submitted power vs frequency data, then compared to paper-reported values (17%/-14%) with ±2 pp tolerance. T1 is straightforward.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for max power increase (%) and decrease (%) due to 100-µm polythene membrane for PC4 probe.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (PC4 row) and explicit text: maximum increase 17%, maximum reduction -14%.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers for the same configuration.

outputs.description: Power output curves for the five-layer probe model; the checker recomputes the maximum percentage increase and decrease due to the membrane and compares to the paper’s reference values.

output_contract.notes: The model parameters (from Table 1: PC4 piezoelectric disk, stainless steel, polythene, air, water) are specified in the instruction. The solver must handle all layer boundary matching internally.
